items.title: Lords call for Flood Re-style safety net for cyber as they warn UK is unready for cascading crises
items.summary: The House of Lords national resilience committee has urged the government to keep Flood Re running beyond 2039 and adapt its model to insure the UK against large-scale cyberattacks.

items.title: L&G reports mixed Q3 with eight consecutive quarters of net new revenue growth
items.summary: Legal & General posted annualised net new revenue growth for the eighth straight quarter in its Q3 update while its assets under management fell.

items.title: Envelop secures Lloyd's approval for Syndicate 1925 and expands into casualty
items.summary: Cyber specialist Envelop has received final regulatory clearance from Lloyd's to launch Syndicate 1925 on January 1, 2027, adding casualty and financial lines treaty reinsurance to its underwriting remit.

items.title: L&G confirms 1,000 job cuts as pension buyout volumes surge 54%
items.summary: Legal & General has confirmed plans to reduce its workforce by 1,000 roles by mid-2027 while reporting strong third-quarter growth in pension risk transfer and workplace pension volumes.

items.title: IMS executive argues black box insurers must improve transparency and data practices
items.summary: Telematics providers suggest that motor insurers could lift low UK take-up rates by clarifying data privacy terms and shifting score generation to mobile devices.

items.title: IDF teams up with UK government to create insurance partnership for developing economies
items.summary: The Insurance Development Forum has entered into an agreement with the UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office to create an insurance partnership for developing economies.
